summary: Bounded proxy topology with measured native HTTP transport rates and separate completed-request observations
description: Requires current analytics:list and proxy_hosts:list permissions; owner visibility is applied before aggregation. Persisted Traffic Flow settings enable completion observations and desired live measurement by default. Effective live measurement requires a successful native Nginx module capability check. Client display defaults to masked prefixes, with explicit address or hidden choices; settings are admin-only. Live HTTP/1, HTTP/2 stream, WebSocket and qualified HTTP/3 rates use monotonic per-request/attempt counter deltas; unsupported, stale, reset and incomplete rates remain null. Not packet/wire bytes or TCP acknowledgements. UDP sampling is best effort; sample_complete is always false. poll_interval_ms is 1000 while fresh authorized native samples exist, otherwise 5000.

200.description: Snapshot with configuration revision, source capabilities, bounded authorized hosts and masked groups, upload/download rates with measurement window and smoothing, collector state and poll_interval_ms. Native protocol coverage is HTTP/1, HTTP/2 streams and WebSocket upgrades; HTTP/3 requires explicit acknowledged/consumed stream quality; incomplete final acknowledgement coverage remains unknown; completion observations remain separate.
